skill.displayName: CrossFit Coach Video — WOD Highlight and Athlete Development Videos for CrossFit Coaches and Affiliate Box Owners
skill.summary: Creates coaching and scaling videos for CrossFit workouts to showcase gym community, athlete progress, and inclusive programming to attract and retain members.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of CrossFit Coach Video.

- Provides video assistance for CrossFit coaches, box owners, and functional fitness program directors.
- Enables creation of WOD highlight clips, scaling demonstration videos, and coaching instruction videos.
- Supports athlete development content—tracking progress like first pull-ups, milestone workouts, and competition debuts.
- Aims to showcase gym community, coaching expertise, and inclusive atmosphere to attract and retain members.
